title: Moving clock: a ring clock carried by a body in the record background

key_results.statement: Decoupled body: $q(a;\lambda)=\lvert\langle a\vert e^{-iD'\lambda}\vert\eta\rangle\rvert^2$ exactly for all $\lambda$; it depends neither on $H$, nor on $\phi_X$, nor on the $K_x$ (nor on $\chi$).

Locality bound for the chain limit $L\to\infty$ (taken first, at fixed $\lambda$): a start supported in $\lvert x\rvert\le R$ has weight amplitude at most $\sum_{n\ge L-R}(\tau\lambda)^n/n!$ beyond $\lvert x\rvert\ge L$; $\bar x$ and $v$ converge because $\lVert i[C,x]\rVert\le\tau$.

For each clock level $d_k$ the eigenvalues of $C_b$ are $\pm\omega_k(p)=\pm\sqrt{(m+d_k)^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$, with eigenvectors $\lvert p\rangle\otimes\beta_{k,\pm}(p)\otimes\lvert f_k\rangle$ and $\tan\theta_k=-\tau\sin p/(m+d_k)$.
Weak records, positive branch of level $k$ near $p_0$: $v=\kappa\sigma_X\,w_k(p_0)\,\hat e$ with $w_k(p)=\tau^2\sin p\cos p/\omega_k(p)$, independent of $\lambda$ and with no expansion in $\epsilon$.
Largest velocity over $p_0$ at level $k$: $v_{{\rm top},k}=\kappa\sigma_X(\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2}-\mu_k)$ with $\mu_k=m+d_k$, attained at $\sin^2p_0=\mu_k/(\mu_k+\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2})$.
The bound (17.7) of 03-ilang-space/17-motion for this $C_b$ is $v_{\max}=\tau\kappa\sigma_X$; it is strictly larger than the largest velocity (5.10).

Band-centre expansion of $\omega_k$ with $\bar\mu=m+\langle0\vert D\vert0\rangle=m+\frac{\pi(N-1)}{N\lambda_0}$, $\bar\omega(p)=\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$ and the rate $\Gamma(p)=\bar\mu/\bar\omega(p)$.

To first order in $\epsilon=\frac{2\pi}{N\lambda_0m}$ at fixed $\lambda/\lambda_0$: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\Gamma(p_0)\lambda/\lambda_0)$, i.e. (2.13) with $\lambda\to\Gamma(p_0)\lambda$, where $\Gamma=\gamma[1+\frac{(N-1)\epsilon}{2}(1-\gamma^2)]+O((N\epsilon)^2)$, $\gamma=m/\omega_0(p_0)$; remainder $O((N\epsilon)^2(1+\lambda/\lambda_0)^2)+O(\delta p^2)+O(\kappa)$.

Tick $\lambda_0(p_0)=\lambda_0/\Gamma(p_0)$ and ratio $R=\lambda_0(p_0)/\lambda_0(0)=\sqrt{1+(\tau/\bar\mu)^2\sin^2p_0}=\frac{\omega}{m}[1-\frac{(N-1)\epsilon}{2}\frac{\tau^2\sin^2p_0}{\omega^2}]+O((N\epsilon)^2)\ge1$, with $\omega=\sqrt{m^2+\tau^2\sin^2p_0}$.

Near the tick, with $\xi=\lambda/\lambda_0(p_0)-1$: $1-q(1;\lambda)=\frac{\pi^2(N^2-1)}{3N^2}\xi^2+O(\xi^4)+O((N\epsilon)^2)$; certainty holds to first order only, and the certainty condition alone fixes the tick only to relative $O(N\epsilon)$.

Label velocity of the item-3 start under weak records: the average over levels and packet of $\cos2\delta_k\,w_k-\sin2\delta_k\,\tau\cos p\cos\theta_k\cos(2\omega_k\lambda)$; the oscillating part is of first order in $\epsilon$ with zero mean, and at $\lambda=0$ the velocity is exactly the level-0 velocity $\kappa\sigma_X w_0(p_0)\hat e$ of (5.9).

Drift velocity of the clock-carrying start (mean of $v$ over $[0,\lambda]$, $\lambda$ a tick or longer), to first order in $\epsilon$: $\bar v=\kappa\sigma_X\,\bar w(p_0)\,\hat e$ with $\bar w(p)=\tau^2\sin p\cos p/\bar\omega(p)$, the level average of the $w_k$.

Instantaneous velocity of the clock-carrying start to first order in $\epsilon$: $v(\lambda)=\kappa\sigma_X\,\bar w(p_0)[1+\epsilon\,\Gamma(p_0)^2c(\lambda)]\hat e$, where $c(\lambda)$ is the packet average of $\frac1N\sum_{k}k\cos(2\omega_k\lambda)$ and $\lvert c(\lambda)\rvert\le c(0)=\frac{N-1}{2}$.

Item 4, reading (i), exact relation on the chain between the tick ratio and the item-2(b) velocity $w_k=\lVert v_k\rVert/(\kappa\sigma_X)$ at level $d_k$: $\bar\mu^4(R^2-1)^2-\bar\mu^2(\tau^2-w_k^2)(R^2-1)+\mu_k^2w_k^2=0$; an identity between (5.22) and (5.9), valid up to the second-order terms of (5.21) in $R$.

Reading (i): $R^2=1+[\tau^2-w_k^2\mp\sqrt{(\tau^2-w_k^2)^2-4\mu_k^2w_k^2}]/(2\bar\mu^2)$, two-valued in $w_k$; sign $-$ on the branch through $p_0=0$, i.e. for $\sin^2p_0\le\mu_k/(\mu_k+W_k)$, $W_k=\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2}$.

Reading (i), small $p_0$: $R=1+\frac{\mu_k^2}{\bar\mu^2}\frac{\lVert v_k\rVert^2}{2v_{\max}^2}+O(p_0^4)$ with $\mu_k^2/\bar\mu^2=1+(2k-N+1)\epsilon+O((N\epsilon)^2)$; the coefficient depends on $k$, $N$, $\epsilon$ at first order and equals $\frac12$ only at zeroth order or for $\mu_k=\bar\mu$; in units of $v_{{\rm top},k}$ it is $\frac{\mu_k^2}{\bar\mu^2}\frac{W_k-\mu_k}{2(W_k+\mu_k)}$.

Reading (i), comparison with the bound: $R^2(1-\lVert v_k\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2)=\frac{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p_0}{\mu_k^2+\tau^2\sin^2p_0}\cdot\frac{\mu_k^2+\tau^2\sin^4p_0}{\bar\mu^2}=1+(\tau^2/\bar\mu^2-\tau^2/\mu_k^2)p_0^2+O(p_0^4)$; always $\lVert v_k\rVert\le v_{{\rm top},k}<v_{\max}$.

Item 4, reading (ii)(a), exact relation on the chain between the tick ratio and the drift velocity $\bar w=\lVert\bar v\rVert/(\kappa\sigma_X)$: $\bar\mu^2R^4-(\bar W^2+\bar\mu^2-\bar w^2)R^2+\bar W^2=0$ with $\bar W=\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2}$, valid to first order in $\epsilon$.

Reading (ii)(a): $R=[\sqrt{(\bar W+\bar\mu)^2-\bar w^2}\mp\sqrt{(\bar W-\bar\mu)^2-\bar w^2}]/(2\bar\mu)$, two-valued in $\bar w$; sign $-$ on the branch through $p_0=0$, i.e. for $\sin^2p_0\le\bar\mu/(\bar\mu+\bar W)$.

Reading (ii)(a), small $p_0$: $R=1+\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/(2v_{\max}^2)+O(p_0^4)=1+\frac{\bar W-\bar\mu}{2(\bar W+\bar\mu)}\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/v_{\rm top}^2+O(p_0^4)$; the coefficient $\frac12$ in units of $v_{\max}$ holds for all $\tau$, $m$, $N$ up to $O((N\epsilon)^2)$, for the drift velocity only.

Reading (ii)(a), comparison with the bound: $R^2(1-\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2)=1+(\tau/\bar\mu)^2\sin^4p_0$; the bound is never reached, since $\lVert\bar v\rVert/v_{\max}\le(\bar W-\bar\mu)/\tau<1$.

Reading (ii)(b), instantaneous velocity $w(\lambda)=\lVert v(\lambda)\rVert/(\kappa\sigma_X)$, to first order in $\epsilon$: $\bar\mu^2R^4-(\bar W^2+\bar\mu^2-w(\lambda)^2)R^2+\bar W^2-2\epsilon\,c(\lambda)w(\lambda)^2=0$ and $R=1+[1-2\epsilon\,c(\lambda)]\lVert v(\lambda)\rVert^2/(2v_{\max}^2)+O(p_0^4)$; the relation depends on $\lambda$ and reduces at $\lambda=0$ to reading (i) at $k=0$.

open_issues: Reading (i) connects two different starts: the tick ratio belongs to the clock-carrying start, the velocity v_k to a start whose clock label is in f_k and whose clock reading does not change; which reading a later package uses is its choice, and a λ-independent relation with the coefficient 1/2 exists to first order in ε for the drift velocity only.

Terms of second order in ε are not computed (branch mixing, dispersion beyond the quadratic term); they make the certainty at the tick inexact at order (Nε)² and limit (5.21) to fewer than about 1/(Nε) ticks.

The first-order term of the tick (5.22) is defined through the rate of the first-order distribution (5.21); the certainty condition applied to the actual reading resolves the tick only to relative order Nε, by (5.23).

The item-3 start is read as the product start with the spinor of level 0 and the clock label exactly in place 0; the start projected on the positive branch of every level gives the same (5.21) and (5.25) to this order without the oscillating part of (5.24) and (5.30), but is not worked out.
Effects of the records beyond leading order in κ are out of scope: the drift from the mean of X and the decoherence of the view.

(5.10) of 03-ilang-space/05-recording-contract assumes a start with all place weights nonzero, while the item-3 start has zero weights; only the record vectors and the distance d_0 are used, which do not depend on the start.
The comparison of two carried clocks between two meetings is left to a later package.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: τ, m, d_k, μ_k, μ̄, w_k and C have dimension 1/λ; ε, Γ, R, ζ, c(λ), μ_k/μ̄ and w/τ are dimensionless; v has the dimension of κσ_X times C; (5.31) is homogeneous of degree 4 and (5.26), (5.35) of degree 2.

p_0 = 0 and τ → 0: (5.12) gives exactly the rest distribution (2.13) with no ε-remainder, Γ = 1, the velocities v_k, the drift velocity and v(λ) vanish, and R = 1 by (5.27) and (5.32) with the sign −.

N = 2: the exact phase-only reading cos²((ω_1 − ω_0)λ/2) agrees with (5.21) up to ε²/24 in the rate; the reading-(i) coefficients (1 − ε)/2 and (1 + ε)/2 of (5.33) have the mean 1/2 of the drift relation (5.28), and (5.35) at λ = 0 gives the level-0 value (1 − ε)/2.

response_to_verification.where: Step 9, equations (5.31) to (5.34), for the velocity of item 2(b) at level k; Steps 8 and 10, equations (5.30) and (5.35), for the instantaneous velocity; Step 10, table, for the restricted claim on the coefficient 1/2
